title: DOLE suspends 6 Atienza shipping vessels after MV June Aster tragedy

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) suspended the operations of six vessels of Atienza Interisland Ferries in relation to the fatal fire incident of MV June Aster, Labor Secretary Francis Tolentino said on Monday. Based on the documents shared to media on Monday, the work stoppage order dated October 12 was issued to the following ships: MV Star San Carlos, MV September Tulips, MV December Poinsettia, MV October Lavender, MV May Lilies, and MV November Cattleya.
